content.title: Where the Conflict Really Lies: Science, Religion, and Naturalism
content.author: Alvin Plantinga (Oxford University Press, 2011)
content.note: Argues that the real conflict is between science and naturalism, not science and theism, and states the evolutionary argument against naturalism. In copyright: described in our own words and cited by chapter or whole work, never quoted; no page numbers are given because no copy is held.
